test_accounting: All qualification commands ran on the clean committed revision, with one Cargo build job. Counts are taken from each runner log; native-only cases are absent from the WASM configuration, not ignored. Development repeats and publication-ledger tests are excluded.
source_hash_format: SHA-256 of committed Git blob bytes
implementation: IC and NODESET share one parser and stage complete StartupDirectiveEntry vectors. No partial execution values or provenance records publish when a card fails; the existing entry representation avoids a second staging data model.

IC, NODESET and inline INITCOND retain their first ordinary card failure through the existing TEMP/TNOM retry contract. The rest of a failed startup card owns no temperature declarations and is skipped. A fresh source pass must validate every active card; no fallback value or empty successful record replaces an error.

Successful source-order evaluation, scoped expressions, canonical/authored/qualified node identities, duplicate validation, typed INITCOND failures, terminal resource/cancellation behavior and finite replay budgets remain authoritative.
acceptance_evidence: Twelve portable regressions cover scalar TEMP and forward TNOM, IC/device-IC transient starts, NODESET release, bare/wrapped/continued multi-entry syntax, source-order parameter values, scoped differential overrides in ngspice/Xyce dialects, malformed/nonfinite/redefined/unused values, device duplicates and value lists, exact random phases, inactive/cyclic hints, included physical origins and terminal resource priority.

Independent circuit checks require a 1 V UIC start, a 7 V NODESET released to the 1 V resistor-divider solution within 1e-9 V, and scoped 2/3 V overrides at transient startup. Existing differential-startup and checkpoint suites qualify related solver integration.

Private tests prove failed cards leave neither partial values nor provenance, previous successful records survive, every observed cancellation boundary stops without later polls, and physical TEMP overrides precede authored temperature cards.
